name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: TanStack Table driving the Keyline table parts: useDataTable (sorting, multi-sort, filters, a search, paging, row selection, column visibility; each slice controlled or not) and DataTable, DataTableBulkBar, DataTablePagination and DataTableSearch. Selecting a row re-renders that row alone.
whenToUse: Use it when rows need sorting, filtering, paging and selection worked out for you, on TanStack Table. For a table whose data and state you manage yourself use Table.

parts.name: DataTable
parts.description: The rows of a TanStack table as Keyline table parts: sort headers with aria-sort and the sort order, an index column of selection checkboxes (Shift extends a range), rows that expand into a detail, and the loading, error and empty rows. Put it in a TableScroll.

props.name: bodyProps
props.description: Props for the body (a `ref` for useRowMotion).

props.name: caption
props.description: The table's name, read before its rows (a TableCaption).

props.name: empty
props.type: { title: ReactNode; body?: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode; count?: ReactNode; }
props.description: What shows when no row passes the filters (an Empty spanning the grid).

props.name: error
props.type: { title: ReactNode; body?: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode; count?: ReactNode; }
props.description: Data failed to load: an error row (announced) in place of the rows.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: The expand toggle's name for a row. Default: "Show details" / "Hide details".

props.name: loading
props.description: While data loads: a page of loading rows in place of the rows (mark the frame `aria-busy`).

props.name: renderDetail
props.description: A row's detail, shown under it while it is expanded (the `expanded` slice). Adds an expand column; the row's index cell spans its detail. Keep the function stable: a new one re-renders every row.

props.name: rowCode
props.description: The index column's code for a row: its place across pages ("01") by default; null prints none.

props.name: rowLabel
props.description: The selection checkbox's name for a row ("Select SH-20481"). Default: "Select row" and its code.

props.name: rowProps
props.description: Props for a row's TableRow (an onClick, a data attribute). Keep the function stable: a new one re-renders every row.

parts.name: DataTableBulkBar
parts.description: The bulk bar over a Data Table's selection: the count (announced politely), the scope, the actions. It re-renders on its own when the selection changes.

props.name: children
props.description: the actions; a function of the selected count (to disable them at 0)

props.name: scope
props.description: what the selection covers; a function of the selected count

props.name: children
props.description: fills the cell between the range and the buttons (a ToastDock)

props.name: loading
props.description: while data loads the range shows "–" and the buttons are off
